subject.title: fix(codex): keep root memory in bootstrap context

question: Should native Codex default to injecting configured-workspace root `MEMORY.md` into bounded turn context when memory tools are available, replacing the current tool-routed pointer default?
rationale: Both routes are intentional product policies with different privacy/prompt-budget and recall tradeoffs; repository history shows the current route was deliberately introduced, so code review cannot select the default without maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt bounded bootstrap memory
options.body: Accept root MEMORY.md as sparse ambient context, then require a current-main rebase and resolved-head validation before merge.

options.title: Keep tool-routed memory
options.body: Retain the current default from the earlier merged Codex routing work and close this branch as an unadopted policy reversal.

options.title: Design an explicit opt-in
options.body: Keep the existing default while asking for a separately approved configuration or prompt-surface policy that enables bounded root-memory injection.

recommendation.title: Adopt bounded bootstrap memory
recommendation.body: Accept root MEMORY.md as sparse ambient context, then require a current-main rebase and resolved-head validation before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The historical merged implementation created the current memory-routing default whose replacement is being considered.
